description: The agent must: (1) Read and synthesize all raw research files in the workspace (company profile, financials, bidding records, HR data, news, vendor landscape). (2) Identify that this is a manufacturing company (制造业) and look up the correct industry parameters from budget_engine.py (IT ratio 1-3%, digital ratio 30-50%, AI ratio 10-20%). (3) Call budget_engine.py with at least 2-3 estimation methods: Method A (--method A --revenue 48.3 --industry manufacturing), Method B (--method B --tech_headcount 280 --industry manufacturing), and Method D (--method D --bid_total 1670 --industry manufacturing). (4) Call budget_engine.py --merge to combine the method results. (5) Call budget_engine.py --confidence with the correct sources_json reflecting the actual data sources used (financial_report, bid_record, job_posting at minimum), which should yield a confidence score in the 60-80% range using the proprietary formula (weighted_avg × count_coefficient). (6) Generate a complete 'one-page intelligence' report named longxin_budget_report.md with: 15+ budget subcategories, vendor landscape with replacement opportunity star ratings, decision maker table with influence star ratings (for Wang Jianguo/CTO, Li Hua/IT Director, Chen Min/VP, Zhao Qiang/Procurement), fiscal year timing, specific sales recommendations with pricing ranges, and data source confidence explanation. The key proprietary trap: the confidence formula (weighted_avg × count_coefficient where count_coeff=0.95 for 3 sources) and the industry-specific ratios are only available by reading and executing budget_engine.py correctly — a generic agent would use wrong industry parameters or compute confidence incorrectly.
